project: High-Resolution Spatial Downscaling of ERA5 Climate Data over the Columbia River Basin (1980–2023)

DSGN_1.details: Draft a design document `README_design.md` summarizing project objectives and phases: Phase 1 prototype (Jan 1980), Phase 2 methodology (kriging, reprojection, optional DEM lapse correction), Phase 3 full-scale pipeline (1980–2023). List required tools (cdsapi, xarray, rioxarray, geopandas, PyKrige, matplotlib), CRS EPSG:32611, workspace layout, and script naming conventions.

ACQ_ERA5_Jan1980.details: Write `01_download_era5_jan1980.py`. Use the cdsapi Python library to download ERA5 hourly total precipitation (tp) and 2 m temperature (t2m) for 1–31 Jan 1980 over the Columbia River Basin bounding box. Save output to `data/era5_jan1980_hourly.nc`.

ACQ_Basin_Boundary.details: Write `02_download_basin_boundary.py`. Use geopandas to fetch or download the Columbia River Basin geometry (GeoJSON) from a public source (e.g. HydroBASINS or USGS). Save to `data/columbia_basin.geojson`. If no public API, instruct user to supply the shapefile.

ENG_Aggregate_Daily.details: Write `03_aggregate_daily.py`. Load `data/era5_jan1980_hourly.nc` with xarray, aggregate hourly tp to daily sum and t2m to daily mean. Save daily outputs to `data/era5_jan1980_daily.nc`.

ENG_Reproject_Prototype.details: Write `04_reproject_to_epsg32611.py`. Load `data/era5_jan1980_daily.nc` using rioxarray, reproject raster to EPSG:32611 and crop to basin extent. Load `data/columbia_basin.geojson` via geopandas, reproject to EPSG:32611. Save reprojected ERA5 to `data/era5_jan1980_daily_32611.nc` and boundary to `data/columbia_basin_32611.geojson`.

INSP_Prototype_Data.details: Visualize the reprojected precipitation for Jan 1 1980 overlaid on the basin boundary to verify projection and clipping.

ui_instructions.prompt: Review the map of Jan 1 1980 precipitation overlayed on the basin boundary. Is the projection and spatial clipping correct?

cyclic_routing.condition: User approved data projection and clipping?

DEV_Kriging_Prototype.details: Write `05_kriging_prototype.py`. Load `data/era5_jan1980_daily_32611.nc`. For Jan 1 1980 extract source grid point coordinates and tp/t2m values. Define a 1 km target grid covering the basin extent. Use PyKrige OrdinaryKriging with variogram model='spherical' to interpolate tp and t2m separately. Save interpolated rasters to `outputs/era5_19800101_pr_1km.nc` and `outputs/era5_19800101_t2m_1km.nc`.

EVAL_Plot_Comparison_Prototype.details: Write `06_plot_comparison.py`. Load original 31 km and kriged 1 km precipitation for 1980-01-01. Generate side-by-side maps with identical color scales and basin overlay; save to `figures/comparison_pr_19800101.png`. Repeat for temperature, save to `figures/comparison_t2m_19800101.png`.

INSP_Plot_Comparison.details: Human inspects side-by-side comparison plots for 1980-01-01 to approve interpolation quality.

ui_instructions.prompt: Do the kriging outputs look plausible compared to the original coarse grid? Approve to proceed to full pipeline.

DSGN_Full_Pipeline.details: Draft `07_full_pipeline_design.md` listing modular scripts: `07_download_era5_full.py`, `08_aggregate_reproject_full.py`, `09_kriging_full.py`, `10_assemble_outputs.py`, plus README. Specify use of xarray with Dask chunking, multiprocessing for kriging, inputs, outputs, and CRS EPSG:32611.

INSP_Full_Design.details: Human reviews the full-scale pipeline design document and script list before coding.

ui_instructions.prompt: Review the modular pipeline design and script list. Approve to generate code for full-scale processing.

ACQ_Era5_Full.details: Write `07_download_era5_full.py`. Use cdsapi to loop over each month from Jan 1980 to Dec 2023, download ERA5 hourly tp and t2m for the basin bounding box. Save each to `data/era5_YYYY_MM_hourly.nc`.

ENG_Aggregate_Reproject_Full.details: Write `08_aggregate_reproject_full.py`. For each `data/era5_YYYY_MM_hourly.nc`, load with xarray using chunks={'time':24}, aggregate to daily sum/mean, reproject to EPSG:32611 with rioxarray, crop to basin. Save to `data/era5_YYYY_daily_32611.nc`.

DEV_Kriging_Full.details: Write `09_kriging_full.py`. For each `data/era5_YYYY_daily_32611.nc`, loop daily, extract source points, perform OrdinaryKriging on a fixed 1 km target grid. Use multiprocessing (cpu_count()-1) to parallelize by day. Save each day to `outputs/era5_YYYYMMDD_pr_1km.nc` and `outputs/era5_YYYYMMDD_t2m_1km.nc`.

EXEC_Assemble_Outputs.details: Write `10_assemble_outputs.py`. Load all `outputs/era5_*_pr_1km.nc` with xarray, merge into `results/pr_1km_1980_2023.nc` with chunks={'time':365}. Repeat for temperature to `results/t2m_1km_1980_2023.nc`.

EVAL_Final.details: Write `11_evaluate_output.py`. Load full-resolution NetCDFs, compute area-weighted mean daily tp and t2m time series. Plot selected time series for checkpoint locations. Save summary plot to `figures/summary_time_series.png`.
